- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover

- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Companion Preview Stage Redesign: Redesign the companion selection view into an interactive preview stage where users can see pet animations and desktop behaviors live before adopting. (why: Adoption redesigns have shown consistent positive lifts (+1.7% average), and adoption currently takes a long median time of 89s / mean 1017s.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Recovery & Persistence Assurance Copy: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in preserves saved pets and prevents profile resets. (why: The top support complaint (8 emails) is pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in copy changes have a proven record of winning tests.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Carousel Path Selection Overview Redesign: Redesign path selection into a carousel view comparing instant starter companions with custom photo-generated pets. (why: Choose_path redesign changes have shown positive results (+1.9% lift), and choose_path has a mean duration of 514s.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Launch Live Progress Status Info: Display detailed progress indicators and estimated loading time on the waiting screen while initializing the desktop engine. (why: Home wait_info changes consistently win (+1.9% lift), addressing the long home step (median 201s / mean 2336s).)
4: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Quality Diagnostic Verification Flow: Add an instant preview checklist and retry option during photo upload to catch bad generation before final adoption. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted pet visual results during onboarding.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Multi-Account Pet Restoration Sign-In Hint: Add a prominent hint under sign-in buttons encouraging users to log into their original account to recover lost pets. (why: 8 users emailed support about missing pets after logging in with different credentials; sign_in hints directly address account confusion.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Render & Overlay Placement Status Info: Show detailed desktop overlay placement status and readiness notification options during launch initialization. (why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on the desktop; home wait_info tests have an established history of positive impact (+1.9%).)
7: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity & Lighting Quality Hint: Provide guidance hints on the photo upload screen explaining photo quality requirements for accurate pet model generation. (why: Custom pet generation failures account for 3 support tickets, and adoption completion rate is a bottleneck.)
8: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Sequence Reorder: Move sign-in after pet adoption certificate creation so users pick and personalize their pet before creating an account. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 46.8%. Delaying account creation until emotional attachment is built increases completion motivation.)
